notes:
**N027.1 — What the page records.** Under the heading “Formules d’associativité,” subsection a) treats real vector spaces. It writes a boxed orientation formula for a finite direct sum, partitions the indexing set into even and odd dimensions, and constructs a concatenated basis from ordered bases and numberings. The margin records restriction of a total order from I to I−, labelled “épi.” The prose compares changes of basis of positive determinant and permutations of the odd and even blocks. These are statements transcribed from the page; the full canonical orientation formula and its coherence were not independently proved in this run.

**N027.2 — Mathematics directing visual inspection.** The extra hooked mark after the first e-index, the first index of the second block, the t|1 character in the final block, the d_1 and d_2 endpoints, the unqualified final i_n, and the inserted numbering of I+ required attention to the displayed basis. The ink-led transcription preserves them, including its remaining doubts. The supplied j-numbering is not extended into unwritten j-indexed terms in the display. The two rank letters read rg in the crop. The inserted conclusion contains two horizontal bars after “définit,” retained as an equals sign. The cancelled exponent before sgn σ− retains its visual alternatives; the sign calculation below has not supplied its letters.

**N027.3 — Actual targeted sign check.** For the page’s adjacent block exchange, write the original ordered vectors as (a_1,…,a_r,b_1,…,b_s) and the exchanged vectors as (b_1,…,b_s,a_1,…,a_r). The corresponding permutation matrix exchanges those coordinate vectors. Exactly rs pairs cross: every a-vector with every b-vector, with the order within each block preserved. The single nonzero term of its determinant is therefore (−1)^(rs). Two odd block sizes give −1; two even block sizes give +1. Multiplying the determinants of the adjacent exchanges gives the signature and +1 statements in the page’s prose. This establishes the local calculation actually used here. It does not decipher the cancelled exponent. The full derivation is in decisions/scan027_math_checks.md.

**N027.4 — Actual targeted restriction-map check.** Restriction r sends a total order on I to its order on I−. Using the inserted numbering of I+, the map s appends that I+ sequence after a given I− sequence. Entrywise restriction gives r∘s = id. This explicit section establishes the surjectivity referred to by the marginal “épi.” The label itself was also read in the crop.

**N027.5 — Author’s markers and sheet identity.** The page has no date or author manuscript page number. Its lower-corner archive number is 26, retained as a comment. The heading and subsection are transcribed in full. No separate authorial “à vérifier,” “sauf erreur,” or question mark was found on this sheet. The visible cancellations, insertions and trailing continuation marks remain part of the diplomatic text; the editorial uncertainty macros belong to this reading, not to the author.
